Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Prior written permission to erect/install a new lift, escalator or moving walk from the Electrical Inspector (Lifts)/Chief Electrical Inspector before starting erection and the same must be carried out only through an approved (licensed) contractor.
Action Required for compliance:
Obtain Prior Approval: Apply for and receive written permission from the Electrical Inspector (Lifts)/Chief Electrical Inspector before starting installation of any new lift, escalator, or moving walk.
Do Not Start Erection Without Approval: Ensure no installation or erection work begins until the required permission is granted.
Use an Approved Contractor: Engage only a licensed/approved lift contractor for erection and installation activities.
Maintain Documentation: Keep copies of approvals, contractor licenses, and installation records for compliance verification.
Forms filed or document submitted to any:
Copies of approvals, 
Contractor licenses, 
Installation records
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33). Erection without permission is also a direct contravention of Section 4(4).
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Give written notice of completion to the Electrical Inspector (Lifts) and apply for a licence to work/use it within one month of completing erection
Action Required for compliance:
Submit Completion Notice: Within one month of completing the erection of the lift, escalator, or moving walk, provide a written notice of completion to the Electrical Inspector (Lifts).
Apply for Operating Licence: Along with or after the completion notice, apply for the required licence to work/use the lift, escalator, or moving walk.
Maintain Supporting Documents: Keep installation completion records, inspection reports, test certificates, and licence application documents for regulatory review.
Do Not Operate Without Licence: Ensure the lift, escalator, or moving walk is not put into use until the required licence is obtained from the competent authority.
Confirm that the completion notice was submitted within one month of installation and that an application for the licence to operate/use has been filed with the Electrical Inspector (Lifts).
Forms filed or document submitted to any:
Installation completion records, inspection reports, 
test certificates, and licence application documents
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33). Using the lift/escalator/moving walk without a working licence is a separate contravention of Section 11.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Licence to be renewed after the expiry of 20 years validity which may be granted for 5 years.
Action Required for compliance:
Track Licence Validity: Maintain records of the working licence and monitor its 20-year validity period from the date of grant.
Apply for Renewal Before Expiry: Submit a renewal application to the Electrical Inspector (Lifts) well before the licence expiration date.
Maintain Documentation: Keep copies of the licence, renewal applications, inspection reports, maintenance records, and modernization certificates.

Verify that the operating licence is valid, renewal applications are submitted before expiry, maintenance requirements are met, and any safety upgrades required by the Electrical Inspector have been completed.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Copies of the licence, renewal applications, inspection reports, maintenance records, and modernization certificates.
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33). Failure to renew in time means the installation cannot lawfully continue to be worked/used (Section 11); Electrical Inspector (Lifts) may also refuse renewal or order use to be discontinued.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Prior written permission of the Electrical Inspector in case of  addition or alteration that changes in characteristics of a lift/escalator/moving walk  except changes directed underunsafe condition orders).
Action Required for compliance:
Obtain Prior Approval for Modifications: Secure written permission from the Electrical Inspector (Lifts) before making any addition or alteration that changes the characteristics of a lift, escalator, or moving walk.
Assess Impact of Changes: Review proposed modifications to determine whether they affect parameters such as:
Passenger/load capacity
Speed
Number of stops/floors
Number of steps or other operational characteristics
Submit Required Documentation: Provide technical details, drawings, and specifications of the proposed changes as required by the authority.
Maintain Approval Records: Retain copies of permissions, modification records, and updated technical documents for inspection and audit purposes.
Exception: Prior permission is not required where changes are carried out pursuant to directions issued under Section 21 relating to unsafe conditions.

Confirm that any modification affecting the operational characteristics of the lift, escalator, or moving walk has received prior written approval from the Electrical Inspector (Lifts).
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Copies of permissions, modification records, and updated technical documents for inspection and audit purposes.
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33).
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Save where the Act/Rules provide otherwise, the relevant Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Code of Practice must be followed; specifications of the lift/escalator/moving walk and the materials/apparatus used in it must conform to the relevant BIS specifications (or the prescribed rules, where BIS specifications do not exist).
Action Required for compliance:
Adhere to Applicable BIS Standards: Ensure the design, installation, operation, maintenance, and testing of lifts, escalators, and moving walks comply with the relevant Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) Codes of Practice.
Use BIS-Compliant Equipment and Materials: Verify that all materials, components, apparatus, and equipment used conform to the applicable BIS specifications.
Follow Prescribed Rules Where BIS Standards Are Not Available: In cases where no relevant BIS specification exists, comply with the requirements prescribed under the Act and Rules.
Obtain and Maintain Compliance Documentation: Keep records of technical specifications, manufacturer certificates, conformity certificates, and test reports demonstrating compliance with applicable standards.
Conduct Periodic Review: Regularly review installations and maintenance practices to ensure continued adherence to updated BIS standards and regulatory requirements.

Confirm that the lift, escalator, or moving walk design, equipment, materials, installation, and maintenance conform to applicable BIS Codes/Specifications or prescribed statutory requirements where BIS standards are unavailable.
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33). Non-conforming installations can also be refused erection permission/working licence, or later be declared unsafe under Section 21.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Maintenance contract with an approved (licensed) contractor for satisfactory maintenance of the lift/escalator/moving walk, covering cleaning, oiling, adjusting and repairing till the handover to the Society
Action Required for compliance:
Enter into a Maintenance Contract: Ensure a valid maintenance contract is executed with an approved/licensed contractor for each lift, escalator, or moving walk.
Engage Only Licensed Contractors: Verify that the maintenance contractor holds a valid licence/approval under the Act.
Cover Essential Maintenance Activities: The maintenance contract should include:
Cleaning
Oiling/Lubrication
Adjustments
Repairs
Routine preventive maintenance
Maintain Maintenance Records: Keep copies of the maintenance agreement, service reports, inspection records, and repair logs for regulatory inspection.
Monitor Contractor Performance: Ensure periodic maintenance is carried out as per the contract to maintain safe and satisfactory operation.

Confirm that a current maintenance contract is in place with a licensed contractor and that regular maintenance activities are being performed and documented.
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33). Proper maintenance is also a pre-condition for renewal of the working licence under Section 8(3).
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Third-party insurance is in place to cover the risk to passengers using it till the handover to the society
Action Required for compliance:
Obtain Third-Party Insurance: Ensure that a valid third-party insurance policy is in place for every lift, escalator, or moving walk after completion of erection.
Cover Passenger Risks: The insurance should adequately cover liabilities and risks arising to passengers using the lift, escalator, or moving walk.
Maintain Continuous Coverage: Monitor policy validity and renew the insurance policy before expiry to avoid any lapse in coverage.
Maintain Insurance Records: Keep copies of insurance policies, renewal certificates, and related documents readily available for inspection and compliance purposes.
Review Coverage Periodically: Ensure the insured amount and policy terms remain adequate based on usage, capacity, and statutory requirements.

Confirm that a valid third-party insurance policy covering passenger risks has been obtained and remains active for each lift, escalator, or moving walk.
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33).
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Maharashtra Lifts, Escalators and Moving Walks Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Maintenance of  a log book for each lift, escalator or moving walk, recording details of its operation, breakdowns (other than failure of electrical supply) and any accidents for the inspection of Electrical Inspector.
Action Required for compliance:
Maintain a Log Book: Keep a separate log book for each lift, escalator, and moving walk.
Record Key Events: Ensure the log book captures:
Operational details
Breakdowns or malfunctions (excluding electrical power supply failures)
Accidents and incidents
Repairs and corrective actions taken

Update Records Regularly: Enter details promptly and accurately whenever an event occurs.
Retain Records for Inspection: Keep log books readily available for review by the Electrical Inspector (Lifts).
Ensure Accessibility and Accuracy: Maintain complete and up-to-date records to demonstrate safe operation and regulatory compliance.

Verify that a log book is maintained for each lift, escalator, and moving walk, containing records of operation, breakdowns, and accidents, and that it is available for inspection by the Electrical Inspector (Lifts).
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to Rs. 50,000; and for a continuing contravention, an additional fine up to Rs. 1,000 for every day of continued default after conviction (Section 32). Officers in charge of a firm/company can also be held liable (Section 33).
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the building has a lift, escalator or moving walk

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Compliance with prescribed fire protection and life safety requirements, including installation, maintenance, and operational readiness of emergency response systems and evacuation arrangements.
Action Required for compliance:
Comply with Fire & Life Safety Requirements: Ensure the building meets all applicable fire protection and life safety provisions prescribed under the National Building Code (NBC).
Install Required Fire Safety Systems: Provide appropriate fire detection, alarm, suppression, firefighting, and emergency communication systems as required for the building occupancy and risk category.
Maintain Fire Protection Systems: Conduct regular inspection, testing, and maintenance of fire safety equipment and systems to ensure operational effectiveness.
Ensure Operational Readiness: Keep all emergency response systems, firefighting equipment, exits, and evacuation routes functional, accessible, and free from obstruction at all times.
Establish Evacuation Arrangements: Maintain emergency evacuation plans, signage, assembly points, and emergency procedures, and conduct periodic drills where applicable.
Maintain Compliance Records: Retain inspection reports, maintenance logs, testing certificates, fire drill records, and statutory approvals for audit and regulatory inspections.

Verify that required fire protection and life safety systems are installed, regularly maintained, operationally ready, and supported by documented emergency response and evacuation procedures in accordance with the National Building Code
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Inspection reports, maintenance logs, testing certificates, fire drill records, and statutory approvals for audit and regulatory inspections.
Penalty/ Implications: Rejection of building occupancy, structural sealing, or penal fines linked with local municipal bylaws.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Operated and maintained in a safe condition through regular inspections, testing, certification, and preventive maintenance activities.
Action Required for compliance:
Conduct Regular Inspections: Periodically inspect all electrical installations and equipment.
Perform Testing and Certification: Ensure electrical systems are tested and certified as required.
Implement Preventive Maintenance: Carry out scheduled maintenance to prevent electrical hazards and failures.

Verify that electrical installations are regularly inspected, tested, certified, and maintained in a safe operating condition.
Penalty/ Implications: Under Section 146 of the Electricity Act, a fine up to ₹100,000 for companies, and daily fines up to ₹5,000 for persistent defaults.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Segregate waste produced at source and processed, stored, and disposed of in accordance with the provisions of the Solid Waste Management Rules.
Action Required for compliance:
Segregate Waste at Source: Separate biodegradable, recyclable, and other waste streams at the point of generation.
Ensure Proper Storage: Store waste in designated containers and locations.
Use Authorized Disposal Methods: Dispose of waste through approved collection and processing agencies.
Maintain Records: Keep waste disposal and vendor documentation.

Verify that waste is segregated, stored, and disposed of in accordance with the Solid Waste Management Rules.
Penalty/ Implications: Spot fines from ₹500 up to ₹25,000 per violation based on municipal limits under NGT "Polluter Pays" frameworks.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Store, handle, and dispose off  only through authorized recyclers or dismantlers as prescribed under the Rules.
Action Required for compliance:
Segregate E-Waste: Identify and separately store electronic and electrical waste.
Use Authorized Recyclers: Dispose of e-waste only through authorized recyclers or dismantlers.
Maintain Disposal Records: Retain handover acknowledgements and certificates from recyclers.
Prevent Unauthorized Disposal: Ensure e-waste is not mixed with general waste.

Verify that all e-waste is disposed of through authorized recyclers and supporting records are maintained.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Handover acknowledgements and certificates from recyclers
Penalty/ Implications: Environmental Compensation (EC) charges calculated by CPCB based on volume, or up to 5 years imprisonment / ₹1 Lakh fine under Section 15 of EPA.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Factories Act, 1948 / State Shops & Establishments Act
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure hygienic working conditions with regular cleaning and maintenance
Action Required for compliance:
Maintain Workplace Cleanliness: Keep premises clean, sanitary, and free from waste accumulation.
Ensure Hygiene Standards: Conduct regular cleaning and sanitation activities.
Control Health Hazards: Implement pest control and housekeeping measures.
Monitor Workplace Conditions: Periodically inspect work areas for cleanliness and safety.

Verify that the workplace is maintained in a clean, hygienic, and safe condition.
Penalty/ Implications: General penalty under Section 92: Fine up to ₹3,000,000 for corporate office offenses; repeating an offense risks up to 2 years imprisonment.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Use vehicles having valid insurance only
Action Required for compliance:
Obtain Vehicle Insurance: Ensure all company vehicles have valid insurance coverage.
Track Policy Expiry Dates: Monitor insurance validity and renew before expiry.
Maintain Insurance Records: Keep copies of policies and renewal documents.
Prevent Uninsured Vehicle Use: Do not operate vehicles without insurance.

Verify that all company-operated vehicles have valid insurance coverage
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Copies of policies and renewal documents
Penalty/ Implications: Punishable under Section 196: ₹2,000 fine and/or up to 3 months imprisonment for the 1st offense.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company owns/operates motor vehicles

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Valid Pollution Under Control (PUC) Certificate is to be maintained
Action Required for compliance:
Obtain PUC Certificates: Ensure vehicles undergo emission checks as required.
Renew PUC Timely: Monitor and renew certificates before expiry.
Maintain Records: Keep valid PUC certificates for all applicable vehicles.
Monitor Emission Compliance: Rectify vehicles failing emission standards.

Verify that all applicable vehicles possess valid PUC certificates.
Penalty/ Implications: Punishable under Section 190(2): ₹10,000 fine plus driving license disqualification for 3 months for a single lapse.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company owns/operates motor vehicles

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: No person shall drive a motor vehicle unless they hold an effective and valid driving licence authorizing them to drive that category of vehicle.
Action Required for compliance:
Verify Driving Licences: Check validity of drivers' licences before vehicle assignment.
Ensure Licence Suitability: Confirm licences are appropriate for the vehicle category.
Maintain Licence Records: Retain copies of valid driving licences.
Monitor Renewals: Track licence expiry dates and renewals.

Verify that all drivers possess valid and appropriate driving licences.
Penalty/ Implications: Punishable under Section 181: Fine of ₹5,000 levied against the driver.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company owns/operates motor vehicles

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: valid passports and maintain updated passport-related records to be maintened fro employees undertaking international travel on official assignments.
Action Required for compliance:
Verify Passport Validity: Ensure employees travelling internationally hold valid passports.
Track Expiry Dates: Monitor passport validity before overseas travel.
Maintain Passport Records: Keep updated passport details for travelling employees.
Ensure Timely Renewals: Complete passport renewals before expiry where required.

Verify that employees undertaking international travel possess valid passports and updated records are maintained.
Penalty/ Implications: Fine up to ₹5,000 and/or imprisonment up to 2 years for providing false deployment declarations or unverified credentials.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only when employees undertake official international travel

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Maharashtra Fire Prevention & Life Safety Measures Act, 2023
Brief Description of compliance: Prescribed fire-prevention and life-safety measures and maintain them in good repair/efficient condition
Action Required for compliance: Identify building classification; provide all prescribed active/passive fire systems; maintain them continuously and renew the annual Fire NOC/safety certification with the local fire authority.
Forms filed or document submitted to any:
1. Sanction Plans- 1 Sets
2. Evaluation checklist
3. Architect Application
4. Provisional Fire NOC
5. Commencement certificate.
6. Electrical contractor certificate
7. Lift Licence.
8. Undertaking
9. Authorization letter
10. DG set purchase order
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Registration of every establishment employing building workers.
Action Required for compliance:
Register the establishment with the registering officer under the BOCW Act before commencing building/construction work employing building workers.

Submit Form XII in triplicate to the Registering Officer within 60 days of starting work if you employ 10+ workers. Attach building plan, land documents, and challan.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Reference Section/Rule: Section 38(2) of the BOCW Act and Rule 209 of the BOCW Central Rules, 1998
Brief Description of compliance: Safety Officer to be appointed in establishments employing 500 or more workers.
Action Required for compliance: Appoint a qualified Safety Officer at any site/establishment employing 500 or more building workers and notify the appointment to the authority.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where 500 or more building workers are employed at the establishment

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Reference Section/Rule: Section 38(1) of the BOCW Act and Rule 208 of the BOCW Central Rules, 1998
Brief Description of compliance: Constitute and function the Safety Committee.
Action Required for compliance: Constitute a Safety Committee with worker and management representation and hold its meetings/functions monthly, maintaining minutes.
Due Date: Non-compliance may attract action by Labour Authority.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Prescribe safety and health measures; many State BOCW Rules specifically require a Health & Safety Policy for large projects.
Action Required for compliance: Adopt and implement a documented Health & Safety Policy covering the safety and health measures prescribed for the project.
Due Date: May be treated as safety management deficiency.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Provide information, instruction, training and supervision to workers regarding safety.
Action Required for compliance: Conduct monthly safety information, instruction, training and supervision sessions for workers and maintain attendance/training records.
Penalty/ Implications: May lead to enforcement action after accidents.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Safety requirements for ladders, roofs, working platforms, guardrails, fall protection and work at height.
Action Required for compliance: Provide and inspect ladders, roofs, working platforms, guardrails and fall-protection systems monthly to ensure compliance with height-work safety rules.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Design, erection, inspection and safe use of scaffolds by competent persons.
Action Required for compliance: Ensure scaffolds are designed, erected and inspected monthly by a competent person before use, with records maintained.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Excavation, trenching, shoring, sloping, barricading and safe access.
Action Required for compliance: Implement and monthly inspect excavation/trenching safeguards - shoring, sloping, barricading and safe access - at all active excavation sites.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: First aid boxes, trained first aid personnel and medical facilities.
Action Required for compliance: Provide adequately stocked first-aid boxes, trained first-aid personnel and on-site medical facilities as prescribed, and verify one-time compliance at project start.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Establish procedures for emergencies such as fire, collapse and rescue.
Action Required for compliance: Establish and document an Emergency Response Plan covering fire, collapse and rescue procedures, and review/update it monthly.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Periodic emergency drills are generally mandated through State BOCW Rules
Action Required for compliance: Conduct periodic (monthly) emergency mock drills as per the project safety plan and maintain drill records.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Employers shall provide and ensure use of suitable PPE including helmets, safety belts, shoes, gloves, eye and respiratory protection.
Action Required for compliance: Issue suitable PPE (helmets, safety belts, shoes, gloves, eye/respiratory protection) to all workers and monitor usage monthly.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Examination, testing, certification and safe use of cranes, hoists, lifting tackles and lifting appliances by competent persons.
Action Required for compliance: Get cranes, hoists, lifting tackles and lifting appliances examined, tested and certified by a competent person on a monthly basis and maintain certificates.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where cranes, hoists or lifting appliances are deployed at site

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Installation, testing, examination, certification and commissioning before use.
Action Required for compliance: Obtain installation testing, examination, certification and commissioning clearance for lifting equipment before it is first put into use.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: TPI Certificate, Load Test Certificate, Erection & Commissioning Certificate (maintained on site)
Due Date: Before first use, after re-erection, alteration or major repair
Penalty/ Implications: Equipment may be prohibited from operation, legal action and liability in case of accidents.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where cranes, hoists or lifting appliances are deployed at site

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Periodic inspection, maintenance and safe operation of machinery and lifting equipment.
Action Required for compliance: Draw up and follow a periodic inspection and maintenance schedule for machinery and lifting equipment to ensure safe operation.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Preventive Maintenance Records, Equipment Inspection Register
Due Date: As per manufacturer's schedule and project requirements
Penalty/ Implications: Penalties for unsafe machinery; increased liability in case of incidents.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where cranes, hoists or lifting appliances are deployed at site

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Machinery and lifting equipment shall be operated only by trained and competent persons.
Action Required for compliance: Permit machinery and lifting equipment to be operated only by trained and certified/competent operators; maintain competency records.
Due Date: Before deployment of operator and whenever a new operator is assigned
Penalty/ Implications: Legal liability and penalties for operation by unqualified personnel.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where cranes, hoists or lifting appliances are deployed at site

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Safe Working Load (SWL), load charts, lifting accessories and lifting operations shall comply with statutory requirements.
Action Required for compliance: Display Safe Working Load (SWL) and load charts on lifting equipment and ensure lifting operations/accessories comply with statutory limits.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Lifting Accessories Test Certificates, SWL Certificates
Due Date: Before use and at prescribed intervals
Penalty/ Implications: Unsafe lifting operations may lead to prohibition of use, penalties and accident liability.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where cranes, hoists or lifting appliances are deployed at site

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020 (as implemented) and BOCW Act
Reference Section/Rule: Sections 38–41 of the BOCW Act and Section 6 of the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure safe plant, machinery, systems of work, supervision and welfare of workers.
Action Required for compliance: Ensure plant, machinery, systems of work, supervision and worker welfare facilities meet the safety standards under the BOCW Act and OSH Code, and review annually.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: SOPs, Pre-start Checklists, Incident Reports (where applicable)
Due Date: Continuous throughout project duration and immediately upon any unsafe condition
Penalty/ Implications: Regulatory action, work stoppage, fines and prosecution in case of serious violations or accidents.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: The ambient air quality standards in respect of noise for different areas/zones shall be such as specified in the Schedule.
Action Required for compliance: Monitor and keep ambient noise levels within the zone-wise standards specified in the Schedule on an ongoing basis.
Penalty/ Implications: Action under Environment (Protection) Act, 1986; closure directions, environmental compensation and prosecution.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: The State Government shall categorize areas into industrial, commercial, residential or silence areas/zones.
Action Required for compliance: Confirm the project site's area classification (industrial/commercial/residential/silence zone) as notified by the State Government and plan activities accordingly.
Penalty/ Implications: Regulatory action for non-compliance with applicable standards.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: A loudspeaker or public address system shall not be used except after obtaining written permission from the authority.
Action Required for compliance: Obtain written permission from the competent authority before using any loudspeaker or public address system at the site.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: FSI Calculation Sheet verified by Architect
Penalty/ Implications: Seizure, stoppage of event, prosecution and local authority action.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Sound emitting construction equipment shall not be used during night time in residential areas and silence zones except in public interest.
Action Required for compliance: Schedule construction equipment operation to avoid night-time use in residential areas and silence zones, except where permitted in public interest.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Water Connection Application submitted to Municipal Water Dept
Penalty/ Implications: Work stoppage, environmental compensation and prosecution.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Construction activities shall be undertaken in compliance with prescribed noise restrictions and timing requirements.
Action Required for compliance: Schedule construction activities to comply with prescribed noise restrictions and permitted working hours.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Environment clearance Act 2006 and its subsequent amendment
Brief Description of compliance: Environment clerance is to be obtained for those project whose BUA area is 20000 Sqm and and above or area covering 50ha are applicable to get Environment clerance

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974

Action Required for compliance: Apply for and obtain Consent to Establish under the Water Act before commencement of construction or installation of any outlet likely to discharge sewage/trade effluent.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: CTE Application, Project Report, Layout Plan

Penalty/ Implications: Imprisonment 1 year 6 months to 6 years and fine under Section 44.
