Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974
Brief Description of compliance: Prohibition on Pollution of Water
Action Required for compliance: Ensure no poisonous, noxious or polluting matter is discharged into any stream, well or sewer without treatment, in line with the Water Act's pollution-prohibition provisions.
Penalty/ Implications: Imprisonment not less than 1 year 6 months, extendable to 6 years, with fine.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Responsibility of Occupier
Action Required for compliance: As occupier of hazardous/other waste generating premises, take responsibility for environmentally sound handling, storage and disposal of such waste as prescribed.
Penalty/ Implications: Action under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 including penalties under Section 15.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Authorization
Action Required for compliance: Apply for and obtain authorisation from the State Pollution Control Board before generating, storing, treating, transporting or disposing of hazardous/other waste.
Penalty/ Implications: Before commencement of activity; renewal before expiry
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Annual Return
Action Required for compliance: Prepare and file the Annual Return on hazardous/other waste generation and disposal with the State Pollution Control Board by the prescribed date each year.
Penalty/ Implications: On or before 30th June following the financial year-Action under the Environment (Protection) Act, 1986 for non-submission.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Construction & Demolition Waste
Action Required for compliance: Segregate, store and process construction & demolition waste at source on an ongoing basis in compliance with the Solid Waste Management Rules.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Disposal to Landfill
Action Required for compliance: Ensure only waste that cannot be processed/recycled is sent to landfill, and route it through authorised disposal facilities as per Rule 15(zi).
Penalty/ Implications: Statutory action under the Environment (Protection) Act
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Every waste generator shall be responsible for collection, segregation of concrete, soil and others and storage of construction and demolition waste generated, as directed or notified by the concerned local authority.
Action Required for compliance: As waste generator, collect, segregate (concrete, soil, etc.) and store C&D waste as directed/notified by the local authority.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Form A Online Application & Fee Challan
Penalty/ Implications: Action under Environment (Protection) Act, 1986, including directions, fines and prosecution.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: The generator shall ensure that other waste (such as solid waste) does not get mixed with construction and demolition waste and is stored and disposed separately.
Action Required for compliance: Keep other solid waste streams separate from construction & demolition waste and arrange separate storage and disposal for each.
Penalty/ Implications: Environmental enforcement action and local authority penalties.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generators generating more than 20 tonnes in one day or 300 tonnes per project in a month shall segregate waste into separate streams including concrete, soil, steel, wood and plastics, bricks and mortar.
Action Required for compliance: Where C&D waste generation exceeds 20 tonnes/day or 300 tonnes/project/month, segregate waste into concrete, soil, steel, wood, plastics, bricks and mortar streams.
Penalty/ Implications: Refusal of project permissions and environmental action.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where C&D waste generation exceeds 20 tonnes/day or 300 tonnes/project/month

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generators generating more than 20 tonnes per day or 300 tonnes per month shall submit waste management plan and obtain approvals before construction, demolition or remodelling work.
Action Required for compliance: For generation above the 20 tonnes/day or 300 tonnes/month threshold, prepare and submit a Waste Management Plan and obtain approval before starting construction/demolition/remodelling.
Penalty/ Implications: Project approval may be withheld; environmental proceedings may be initiated.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where C&D waste generation exceeds 20 tonnes/day or 300 tonnes/project/month

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generators shall obtain appropriate approvals from the local authority before starting construction, demolition or remodelling work.
Action Required for compliance: Obtain the requisite approvals from the local authority before commencing construction, demolition or remodelling work generating C&D waste.
Penalty/ Implications: Stop-work directions and penalties under applicable municipal laws.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generators shall keep the concerned authorities informed regarding relevant activities from planning stage to implementation stage.
Action Required for compliance: Keep the local authority informed of C&D waste-related activities from the planning stage through implementation.
Penalty/ Implications: Non-compliance may lead to revocation of approvals and enforcement action.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Every waste generator shall keep construction and demolition waste within the premises.
Action Required for compliance: Store construction and demolition waste within project premises pending collection/disposal, as required.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Form G Application for Agent Registration
Penalty/ Implications: Fines and removal costs imposed by local authority.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generator may get the waste deposited at collection centres established by local authorities.
Action Required for compliance: Where available, deposit C&D waste at collection centres established by the local authority.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Form J Application for Agent Renewal
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generator may hand over construction and demolition waste to authorized processing facilities.
Action Required for compliance: Hand over C&D waste to authorised processing facilities for recycling/disposal.
Penalty/ Implications: Unauthorized disposal may attract environmental penalties.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generator shall ensure that there is no littering or deposition of construction and demolition waste so as to prevent obstruction to traffic, public or drains.
Action Required for compliance: Ensure C&D waste is not littered or deposited so as to obstruct traffic, public areas or drains, and arrange proper containment at site.
Penalty/ Implications: Clean-up costs, municipal fines and environmental action.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Every waste generator shall pay relevant charges for disposal of construction and demolition waste.
Action Required for compliance: Pay the disposal charges for C&D waste as notified by the local authority.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Form 5 Annual Audit Report uploaded on Portal
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generators generating more than 20 tonnes per day or 300 tonnes per month shall pay for processing and disposal of waste generated in addition to storage, collection and transportation charges.
Action Required for compliance: For generators above the 20 tonnes/day or 300 tonnes/month threshold, additionally pay for processing and disposal over and above storage, collection and transportation charges.
Penalty/ Implications: Recovery of dues and enforcement action.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where C&D waste generation exceeds 20 tonnes/day or 300 tonnes/project/month

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Construction and Demolition Waste Management Rules, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Waste generator shall comply with directions issued by the local authority relating to collection, segregation, storage, transportation and disposal of construction and demolition waste.
Action Required for compliance: Comply with all directions issued by the local authority on collection, segregation, storage, transportation and disposal of C&D waste.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Form N Compensation Claim / Reply Statement
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Identify personal data collected from customers, employees, vendors, visitors, brokers and other individuals and map processing activities.
Action Required for compliance: Conduct a one-time data mapping exercise to identify all personal data collected from customers, employees, vendors, visitors and brokers, and keep the data inventory updated on a continuous basis.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty under Section 33 / Schedule, as applicable.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Process personal data only for a lawful purpose based on consent or legitimate uses permitted by the Act.
Action Required for compliance: Process personal data only on the basis of valid consent or a permitted legitimate use, and periodically audit processing activities against this requirement.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty up to ₹50 crore for other breaches, subject to Schedule.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Give clear notice specifying personal data collected and purpose of processing.
Ensure notice is presented independently, in clear and plain language, and provides the required information enabling informed consent.

Provide information regarding how the Data Principal can exercise rights under the Act and how a complaint can be made to the Board.
Action Required for compliance: Issue an independent, clear-language notice at the point of data collection specifying the personal data collected, purpose of processing, and how to exercise rights or complain to the Board.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Obtain consent that is free, specific, informed and unambiguous, with clear affirmative action, for processing personal data for the specified purpose.

Provide a mechanism to withdraw consent that is as easy as giving consent.

Maintain evidence demonstrating that valid consent was obtained in accordance with the Act.
Action Required for compliance: Implement a consent mechanism that captures free, specific, informed and unambiguous affirmative consent, provide an equally easy withdrawal option, and retain consent records as evidence.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Document and verify cases where processing is undertaken under legitimate-use grounds rather than consent.

Process personal data without obtaining consent only where such processing falls within the specified ‘certain legitimate uses’ under Section 7 of the DPDP Act, 2023. Ensure that the processing is undertaken only for the permitted purpose, limited to the personal data necessary for that purpose, and supported by appropriate records demonstrating the applicable legitimate-use basis.”
Action Required for compliance: Where processing without consent, document and verify that it falls strictly within a Section 7 legitimate-use ground, limit it to necessary data, and retain supporting records.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure personal data is accurate and complete where necessary for decisions affecting the Data Principal or disclosure to another Data Fiduciary.
Action Required for compliance: Implement data-quality checks to ensure personal data used for decisions affecting a Data Principal, or shared with another Data Fiduciary, is accurate and complete.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Notify the Data Protection Board and affected Data Principals in the event of a personal data breach, in the prescribed manner.

Notify the Data Protection Board of India without delay. (Nature, Extent, Date and Time, Circumstances, Likely impact, Measures taken)
A detailed update must be furnished within 72 hours, unless the Board permits a longer period.
Action Required for compliance: On any personal data breach, notify the Data Protection Board of India without delay and affected Data Principals as prescribed, furnishing a detailed update within 72 hours.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Erase personal data when its purpose is no longer served, subject to legal retention requirements.
Action Required for compliance: Set up and follow a data retention/erasure schedule to erase personal data once its purpose is served, subject to legal retention requirements.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Obtain verifiable consent of the parent/lawful guardian before processing personal data of a child.
Action Required for compliance: Before processing any child's personal data, obtain verifiable parental/guardian consent and apply the additional restrictions prescribed for children's data.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company processes personal data of children (below 18 years)

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Provide Data Principal information regarding personal data being processed and prescribed details.
Action Required for compliance: On request, provide Data Principals with a summary of their personal data being processed and the other prescribed details.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Provide mechanism for correction of inaccurate data and erasure where legally required.

Complete personal data where the Data Principal identifies that information is incomplete.

Update outdated personal data based on a valid request.

Erase personal data upon a valid erasure request unless retention is necessary for the specified purpose or required by law.
Action Required for compliance: Implement a mechanism to correct, complete, update or erase personal data on a valid Data Principal request, subject to permitted retention exceptions.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Establish an accessible grievance redressal mechanism.

Investigate and respond to grievances within the period prescribed under the Rules or applicable law.

Ensure the Data Principal has an opportunity to use the company's grievance mechanism before approaching the Board.

Respond to the grievance within the period prescribed under applicable law; where no period is prescribed, follow the period specified under the Rules.
Action Required for compliance: Set up an accessible grievance redressal mechanism, respond within the prescribed timeline, and ensure Data Principals can use it before approaching the Board.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Provide mechanism for Data Principal to nominate another individual to exercise rights in specified circumstances.
Action Required for compliance: Provide a mechanism for Data Principals to nominate another individual to exercise their rights in the event of death or incapacity.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Respond to inquiries, complaints and directions of the Data Protection Board.
Action Required for compliance: Respond promptly and fully to inquiries, complaints and directions issued by the Data Protection Board.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
File appeal against Board orders where required.

If aggrieved by an order/direction of the Data Protection Board, assess whether an appeal should be filed before the Appellate Tribunal.

If the appeal is filed after 60 days, provide sufficient cause for delay and seek condonation from the Appellate Tribunal.
Action Required for compliance: On receipt of an adverse Board order, evaluate the merits and file an appeal before the Appellate Tribunal within 60 days, seeking condonation with sufficient cause if delayed.
Penalty/ Implications: Order may become final if appeal is not filed in time.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Ensure electronic records used by the company are maintained in a legally reliable manner.

Ensure documents/information required to be in writing can be generated, stored or made available electronically.
Action Required for compliance: Ensure electronic records and documents required to be in writing are generated, stored and retrieved in a manner that meets IT Act legal-reliability requirements.
Penalty/ Implications: Legal validity of records may be affected if statutory requirements are not met.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Use valid electronic/digital signatures for documents requiring electronic authentication.
Action Required for compliance: Use valid electronic/digital signatures issued by a licensed certifying authority for documents requiring electronic authentication.
Penalty/ Implications: Invalid authentication and related legal consequences.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Safeguard electronic signature certificates and private keys; prevent unauthorised use.
Action Required for compliance: Implement controls to safeguard electronic signature certificates and private keys, and prevent their unauthorised use.
Penalty/ Implications: Liability under applicable provisions of the Act. (India Code)
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Prevent unauthorised access, downloading, copying, introducing malware, disruption or damage to computer resources.
Action Required for compliance: Deploy technical safeguards (access controls, anti-malware, monitoring) to prevent unauthorised access, downloading, copying or damage to computer resources.
Penalty/ Implications: Compensation to affected person for damage caused. (India Code)
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Prevent unauthorised disclosure of electronic records/information obtained under statutory powers.
Action Required for compliance: Restrict and log access to electronic records/information obtained under statutory powers to prevent unauthorised disclosure.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure employees, consultants, vendors and service providers do not disclose personal information obtained under lawful contracts without consent or contrary to contract.
Action Required for compliance: Bind employees, consultants, vendors and service providers under confidentiality/contractual clauses restricting disclosure of personal information obtained under lawful contracts.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Identify sensitive personal data/information collected or processed by the company.

Passwords, Financial information such as bank account, credit/debit card or other payment instrument details,Physical, physiological and mental health condition,Sexual orientation,Medical records and history,Biometric information
Action Required for compliance: Carry out a one-time identification exercise (with periodic review) to map all sensitive personal data or information (passwords, financial data, health data, biometrics, etc.) held by the company.
Penalty/ Implications: Non-compliance may attract consequences under Section 43A.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company collects/processes SPDI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Treat passwords, financial information, physical/mental health condition, sexual orientation, medical records, biometric information and similar prescribed information as SPDI.
Action Required for compliance: Classify and handle passwords, financial information, health/medical data, sexual orientation, and biometric information as SPDI with enhanced safeguards on an ongoing basis.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company collects/processes SPDI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Publish a clear and easily accessible privacy policy explaining the company's practices and policies for handling personal information/SPDI.

Specify the types of personal information and SPDI collected by the company.

State the purposes for which personal information/SPDI is collected and used.

Explain the circumstances and manner in which personal information/SPDI may be disclosed, in accordance with Rule 6.

Describe the reasonable security practices and procedures implemented under Rule 8.
Action Required for compliance: Publish and keep updated a clear privacy policy covering the personal information/SPDI collected, purposes, disclosure practices and security measures under Rule 8.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company collects/processes personal information/SPDI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Obtain consent before collecting SPDI, subject to permitted circumstances.
Action Required for compliance: Obtain consent before collecting SPDI from an individual, except in the circumstances permitted under the Rules.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company collects SPDI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Do not disclose SPDI to third parties without prior permission, except where permitted by law/contract or required by lawful authority.
Action Required for compliance: Do not disclose SPDI to third parties without the provider's prior permission, except where permitted by law/contract or required by a lawful authority.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company discloses SPDI to third parties

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Provide SPDI to Government agencies when disclosure is legally required for specified purposes.
Action Required for compliance: Provide SPDI to Government agencies on receipt of a valid legal request for the specified statutory purposes.
Penalty/ Implications: Legal consequences for failure to comply.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where a Government agency legally requests SPDI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Transfer SPDI to another body corporate/person only where necessary for lawful purposes and subject to applicable consent/contractual and security requirements.
Action Required for compliance: Before transferring SPDI to another body corporate or person, verify the necessity, obtain consent where required, and ensure equivalent security safeguards under contract.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where SPDI is transferred to another body corporate/person

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Conduct periodic review/audit of security controls and practices.
Action Required for compliance: Conduct a periodic review/audit of information security controls and practices as required under Rule 8(3).
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Report specified cyber-security incidents to CERT-In.

Report available information concerning the incident. Complete information need not be available at the initial 6-hour reporting stage.
Action Required for compliance: On occurrence of a reportable cyber-security incident, report available information to CERT-In within 6 hours of noticing/being notified, updating as more facts emerge.
Due Date: Within 6 hours of noticing the incident or being brought to notice
Penalty/ Implications: Under Section 70B(7): imprisonment up to 1 year, or fine up to ₹1 lakh, or both. (CERT-In)
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Identify incidents falling within CERT-In's specified categories, including unauthorised access, data breach, phishing, ransomware, DDoS, malware, website compromise and attacks on critical systems.
Action Required for compliance: Maintain continuous monitoring capability to identify CERT-In notifiable incidents (unauthorised access, data breach, phishing, ransomware, DDoS, malware, website compromise, attacks on critical systems).
Penalty/ Implications: Same Section 70B(7) consequence for failure to comply with directions. (CERT-In)
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Designate a Point of Contact for communication with CERT-In.
Action Required for compliance: Designate a Point of Contact for CERT-In communications and keep the nomination updated whenever the person changes.
Due Date: Before operational compliance / whenever details change
Penalty/ Implications: Section 70B(7) for failure to comply with direction. (CERT-In)
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Enable logs for all ICT systems and maintain them securely.

Maintain ICT system logs securely for a rolling period of at least 180 days.

Submit relevant logs to CERT-In along with reporting of a cyber incident.

Provide logs when CERT-In specifically orders/directs the company to do so.
Action Required for compliance: Enable logging across all ICT systems, retain logs securely for a rolling 180 days, and submit them to CERT-In when reporting an incident or on specific direction.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Employees' Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
Brief Description of compliance:
Register establishment under EPF if applicable, criteria It applies to covered factories and other establishments employing 20 or more persons, subject to Section 16 exemptions and the notified categories, 
Register on: EPFO Portal (Online)
Action Required for compliance: Once headcount reaches 20 or more (subject to Section 16 exemptions), register the establishment under EPF on the EPFO portal within the prescribed time.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment employs 20 or more persons (subject to Section 16 exemptions)

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Employees' Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
Brief Description of compliance:
Deposit the applicable employer contribution to the EPF Fund.
Deduct the employee's applicable EPF contribution from wages and deposit it with EPFO.
The statutory rate is generally 12% for establishments/classes covered by the notified 12% rate; the Act's base provision refers to 10%, with the notified modification substituting 12%. Contributions are calculated on basic wages + dearness allowance + retaining allowance, if any
Action Required for compliance: Deduct the employee's EPF contribution from wages, add the employer's matching contribution (12% of basic + DA + retaining allowance, as notified), and deposit both with EPFO by the monthly due date.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under EPF

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Employees' Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
Brief Description of compliance:
Submit the prescribed consolidated return of employees required/entitled to become EPF members, including applicable wage particulars.
1.Submit the prescribed return for employees becoming EPF members for the first time during the preceding month.
2.Report employees who left service during the preceding month in the prescribed manner.
3.Where applicable, submit a NIL return if there are no new qualifying members or employees leaving service.
Action Required for compliance: File the monthly consolidated EPF return (new joiners, leavers, and NIL return where applicable) with prescribed wage particulars by the due date.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under EPF

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Employees' Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
Brief Description of compliance: Submit a statement to the Principal Employer showing the EPF contribution recoveries relating to employees employed by/through the contractor. Statement must be submitted within 7 days from the close of every month.
Action Required for compliance: As/through contractor, submit the statement of EPF contribution recoveries for contract employees to the Principal Employer within 7 days of the close of each month.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where contract labour is engaged and EPF applies to those employees

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Employees' Provident Funds & Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952
Brief Description of compliance:
Furnish information/documents requested by an EPFO Inspector.
Allow the Inspector to enter and inspect the establishment/premises at a reasonable time.
Produce accounts, books, registers and other documents relating to employment and payment of wages.
Action Required for compliance: On request from an EPFO Inspector, furnish the requisite information/documents, permit inspection of premises, and produce wage and employment registers.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is registered/covered under EPF

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Applicable where 10 or more persons are employed, subject to applicable notifications.
ESI coverage generally applies to employees whose monthly wages do not exceed ₹21,000. For persons with disability, the ceiling is ₹25,000.
Action Required for compliance: Once 10 or more persons are employed, assess ESI applicability for employees drawing wages up to ₹21,000/month (₹25,000 for persons with disability) and enrol them on joining.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where 10 or more persons are employed, subject to wage-ceiling notifications

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Deposit employer's ESI contribution at 3.25% of wages.
Deduct employee's ESI contribution at 0.75% of wages, where applicable.
Action Required for compliance: Deduct the employee's ESI contribution (0.75% of wages) and deposit the employer's contribution (3.25% of wages) with ESIC every month by the due date.
Penalty/ Implications: Delayed payment attracts simple interest at 12% p.a. or the higher rate permitted under the regulations, subject to the statutory limit.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under ESI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Submit prescribed returns to ESIC containing particulars of employees and the establishment in the prescribed form/manner.
Maintain Form 6/Register of Employees containing prescribed particulars of every employee, including name, insurance number, date of birth, date of appointment, nature of employment, wages, contribution details and date/reason for leaving service, and keep the register available for ESIC inspection
Action Required for compliance: File the prescribed periodic ESI returns and maintain Form 6/Register of Employees with all prescribed particulars, available for ESIC inspection.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under ESI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure timely and accurate payment of ESI contributions to prevent loss or reduction of employee benefits; monitor and reconcile contributions regularly and promptly rectify any default, as ESIC may recover from the principal employer the greater of the benefit difference or twice the unpaid contribution
Action Required for compliance: Reconcile ESI contribution deposits regularly and rectify any shortfall/default promptly to avoid recovery action by ESIC.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under ESI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Furnish information/documents requested by the SSO for ESI verification.
Permit the SSO to enter the office, factory or establishment at a reasonable time.
Produce books, accounts, registers and other documents relating to employment and payment of wages.
Action Required for compliance: On request from the Social Security Officer, furnish requested information/documents, permit entry/inspection, and produce wage and employment records.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under ESI

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
No employer shall pay to any employee wages less than
the minimum rate of wages notified by the appropriate Government.
Action Required for compliance: Pay every employee at least the minimum rate of wages notified by the appropriate Government; audit payroll periodically for compliance.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: sets the legal time limits for Employers to disburse wages to employees based on their wage period cycle. It ensures timely payouts across all employment types, regardless of a wage ceiling.
Action Required for compliance: Disburse wages to employees within the statutory time limit applicable to their wage period, for every category of employment.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Pay statutory bonus to every eligible employee drawing wages up to the wage ceiling notified by the Appropriate Government, provided the employee has worked for at least 30 days in the accounting year.
Pay a minimum annual bonus of 8⅓% of the wages earned or ₹100, whichever is higher, even if there is no allocable surplus
Action Required for compliance: Compute and pay statutory bonus to every eligible employee (worked 30+ days in the accounting year) at a minimum of 8-1/3% of wages or Rs.100, whichever is higher, even absent allocable surplus.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Display at a prominent place in the establishment an abstract of the Code, category-wise wage rates, wage period, date/time of wage payment, and the name and address of the jurisdictional Inspector-cum-Facilitator.
Action Required for compliance: Display, at a prominent place, an abstract of the Code, category-wise wage rates, wage period, payment date/time and the jurisdictional Inspector-cum-Facilitator's details.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Generally applies to establishments covered by the Code, including establishments with 10 or more workers, subject to specific provisions/exclusions.
Employer must apply electronically to the registering officer appointed by the appropriate Government.
Application within 60 days from the date the Code becomes applicable to the establishment.
Action Required for compliance: Once covered (10+ workers), apply electronically to the registering officer for OSH Code registration within 60 days of the Code becoming applicable.
Penalty/ Implications: Fine of ₹2 lakh to ₹3 lakh for a first offence, with higher consequences for subsequent/continuing contraventions as prescribed under the penalty framework
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment employs 10 or more workers (subject to exclusions)

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure that machinery, equipment and other articles designed, manufactured, imported or supplied for use in the establishment are safe when properly used, are appropriately tested/examined, and are accompanied by adequate information regarding intended use and necessary safety precautions.
Action Required for compliance: Ensure machinery, equipment and articles used are safety-tested, accompanied by usage/safety information, and reviewed annually for continued compliance.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Provide and maintain all prescribed welfare facilities, including washing and bathing facilities, locker rooms, seating arrangements, canteen, first-aid, rest/shelter rooms, ambulance room, welfare officer and crèche facilities, wherever the prescribed applicability thresholds are met.
Establishments employing more than 50 workers must provide crèche facilities as prescribed.
Action Required for compliance: Provide and maintain the prescribed welfare facilities (washing/bathing, locker rooms, seating, canteen, first-aid, rest rooms, ambulance room, welfare officer, and crèche for 50+ workers) on an ongoing basis.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Crèche facility requirement applicable only where more than 50 workers are employed

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Arrange medical examination of workers in the prescribed manner and at prescribed intervals.
Ensure workers exposed to specified hazardous processes, dangerous operations or occupational risks undergo required medical examinations.
Conduct medical examinations where prescribed before employment and periodically thereafter.
Action Required for compliance: Arrange pre-employment and periodic medical examinations for workers, especially those exposed to hazardous processes, per the prescribed intervals.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Report accidents causing death, bodily injury resulting in inability to work for 48 hours or more, and other prescribed accidents.
Report prescribed dangerous occurrences whether or not they cause injury or disability.
Action Required for compliance: Report to the authority every fatal accident, injury causing 48+ hours' incapacity, and other prescribed accidents/dangerous occurrences as they occur.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Maintain complete and up-to-date statutory registers and records covering worker particulars, working hours, weekly rest, wages, leave, overtime, attendance, dangerous occurrences and adolescent employment; issue wage slips and file prescribed returns with the Inspector-cum-Facilitator within the applicable timelines
Action Required for compliance: Maintain up-to-date statutory registers (worker particulars, hours, wages, leave, overtime, attendance), issue wage slips, and file returns with the Inspector-cum-Facilitator within timelines.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Pay statutory compensation where an employee suffers an employment-related injury covered under the Act.
Ensure accidents occurring arising out of and in the course of employment are assessed for compensation liability.
Action Required for compliance: Assess every employment-related injury for compensation liability and pay statutory compensation where the Act applies.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Compensation payable under Section 4 must be paid as soon as it falls due
Action Required for compliance:
Assess liability immediately
Investigate the accident/injury and determine whether compensation is payable under the Act.

Calculate compensation
Compute the compensation amount as per Section 4 based on wages, age, and nature of injury/death.

Pay compensation without delay
Ensure compensation is paid as soon as it falls due and preferably within one month to avoid statutory consequences.

Make provisional payment if liability is disputed
Where the employer does not accept the full claim, pay the admitted amount provisionally by depositing it with the Commissioner or paying the employee.

Maintain documentation
Keep records of accident reports, compensation calculations, payment proofs, insurance correspondence, and acknowledgements from employees/dependents.

Coordinate with insurer
If covered under a Workmen's/Employees' Compensation Insurance Policy, notify the insurer immediately and process the claim as per policy requirements.

Avoid delayed payment
Delays beyond one month may attract:
Interest at 12% p.a. or applicable notified rate; and
Penalty up to 50% of the compensation amount if the delay is unjustified
Penalty/ Implications: Interest at 12% p.a. (or applicable higher notified rate within the statutory limit) plus, where unjustified delay is established, a penalty of up to 50% of the compensation amount.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure notice of the accident is given to the employer as soon as practicable after the accident.
Action Required for compliance: Ensure every workplace accident is notified to the employer as soon as practicable, via a documented internal reporting process.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Submit accident report
Action Required for compliance: Submit the accident report to the Commissioner for Employees' Compensation in the prescribed form and timeline.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Establishments covered by the applicable Shops & Establishments legislation employing 5 or more persons, including those which have received partial/whole exemption under the relevant Shops Act provision.
5 or more persons employed, or employed on any working day during the preceding 12 months.
Deduct the prescribed employee contribution from wages and add the employer's contribution; deposit both with the Maharashtra Labour Welfare Board.Half-yearly – by 15 July and 15 January
Action Required for compliance: Once 5+ persons are employed, deduct the prescribed employee Labour Welfare Fund contribution and deposit it with the employer's matching share to the Maharashtra LWF Board by 15 July and 15 January.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where 5 or more persons are/were employed at the establishment

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Employer contributes the prescribed amount, currently 3 times the employee contribution.
Action Required for compliance: Contribute the employer's share (currently 3x the employee contribution) to the Labour Welfare Fund along with each half-yearly deposit.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under the Maharashtra LWF Act

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Submit the prescribed return/statement of Labour Welfare Fund contribution to the Maharashtra Labour Welfare Board/competent authority.
Return should contain prescribed particulars of eligible employees and the employee/employer contributions.
Eligible Employees: Persons employed for hire or reward to perform skilled, unskilled, manual, clerical, supervisory or technical work, directly by the employer or through a contractor/agency, excluding persons mainly employed in managerial capacity, supervisory employees drawing wages exceeding ₹3,500 per month or exercising mainly managerial functions, and apprentices under the Apprentices Act, 1961.
Action Required for compliance: File the half-yearly/annual Labour Welfare Fund return with eligible-employee and contribution particulars with the Maharashtra Labour Welfare Board.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under the Maharashtra LWF Act

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Maintain prescribed employee, wage, deduction, employer contribution, return and payment records relating to the Labour Welfare Fund, ensure records are updated and reconciled with payroll, and make them available for inspection by the competent authority.
Action Required for compliance: Maintain and reconcile LWF employee, wage, deduction, contribution, return and payment records with payroll, keeping them ready for inspection.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the establishment is covered under the Maharashtra LWF Act

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Do not employ children below 14 years.
Verify age before recruitment and maintain valid age proof such as birth certificate, school certificate or other prescribed proof.
Action Required for compliance: Verify age proof (birth/school certificate) before recruitment and ensure no child below 14 years is employed.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Do not employ adolescents in hazardous occupations
Action Required for compliance: Screen job roles and ensure no adolescent (14-18 years) is engaged in any hazardous occupation or process listed under the Act.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Maintain age and employment records
Action Required for compliance: Maintain and update age-verification and employment records for all young workers as prescribed.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Maharashtra Shops And Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Condition of Service) Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance:
Prepare and display Form M – Notice of Hours of Work, Rest-Interval, Weekly Holiday.
Mention the working hours from–to for each worker.
Mention the prescribed rest interval from–to.Specify the weekly holiday/day off for each worker.Include worker's name and designation.
Display on the website and at a conspicuous place on the establishment's premises/notice board.
Form M should contain the date, place and signature of the Manager/Authorised Representative.
Action Required for compliance: Prepare Form M each month showing working hours, rest interval and weekly holiday per worker, and display it on the notice board and company website.
Penalty/ Implications: Contravention penalty under Section 29 minimum of Rs. 1,00,000/- and in case of continuing contravention as additional fine which may extend to Rs. 2,000/- for every day during contravention continues.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Maharashtra Shops And Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Condition of Service) Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance:
Prepare and display the shift schedule well in advance.
Use Form N – Notice of Shift Schedule & Weekly Holiday of Workers Engaged in Shift.
Mention name and designation of every worker working in the shift
Specify the applicable shift and working period/dates.
Clearly specify the weekly holiday for each worker.
Display the notice on the website or at a conspicuous place on the establishment's premises/notice board.
Keep Form N available at the establishment for inspection by the Facilitator.
Send a copy to the Facilitator electronically or otherwise.
Update the schedule whenever worker shift allocation changes.
Provide at least 12 consecutive hours of rest/gap when a worker is changed from day shift to night shift or vice versa.
Action Required for compliance: For shift-based operations, prepare Form N (shift schedule & weekly holiday) in advance, display/upload it, share a copy with the Facilitator, update on changes, and ensure 12 hours' rest on shift rotation.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Maharashtra Shops And Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Condition of Service) Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance:
Provide every worker with a Form O – Leave Book.
Retain a copy of the Leave Book/records with the employer.
Record all sanctioned earned leave as prescribed under Section 18.
If earned leave is refused, record the application date, refusal date and reason for refusal, with employer/representative initials.
Maintain leave due, leave availed and accumulated/balance leave.
If the worker loses the Leave Book, provide a duplicate copy.
Action Required for compliance: Issue Form O (Leave Book) to every worker, record sanctioned/refused earned leave with reasons, retain employer copies, and issue duplicates if lost.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Maharashtra Shops And Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Condition of Service) Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance:
File Annual Return in Form R
For the year ending 31 December.
Within 2 months from the end of the calendar year — i.e. generally by 28/29 February
Online upload on the prescribed website/portal
Action Required for compliance: File the Annual Return in Form R for the calendar year ending 31 December on the prescribed portal within 2 months (by 28/29 February).
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Maharashtra Shops And Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Condition of Service) Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance:
Submit Form U – Details of Persons Occupying Position of Confidential Character.
Identify workers/persons who occupy a confidential position and are responsible for confidential work relating to the business.
The number of such persons should not exceed 1% of the total strength of workers, subject to a maximum of 50 persons.
Action Required for compliance: Identify employees in confidential positions (capped at 1% of workforce, max 50) and submit Form U particulars as required.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Maharashtra Shops And Establishments (Regulation of Employment and Condition of Service) Act, 2017
Brief Description of compliance: Issue an identity card to every worker containing the prescribed employer, establishment and worker particulars, including date of joining, department, nature of work, designation, blood group and Aadhaar number, and ensure the worker carries the card for production before the Facilitator when demanded.”
Action Required for compliance: Issue identity cards to every worker with the prescribed particulars and ensure workers carry them for production before the Facilitator on demand.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Work Place Act
Brief Description of compliance:
Private/public organisations, offices, branches, units, factories, institutions, hospitals, etc.
Covers regular, temporary, ad-hoc, daily wage, contract workers, probationers, trainees, apprentices and volunteers.
The Act protects an aggrieved woman of any age, whether employed or not, who alleges sexual harassment at the workplace.
Action Required for compliance: Map all workplace locations and worker categories (including contract/temporary staff) covered by the POSH Act to determine applicability across offices/sites.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty of Rs. 50000/-. Non formation of ICC & Annual Report
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Work Place Act
Brief Description of compliance:
10 or more employees → Internal Committee (IC/ICC) is mandatory.
Presiding Officer – senior woman employee
At least 2 employee members committed to the cause of women/having relevant experience or knowledge
1 external member from an NGO/association or person familiar with sexual-harassment issues
At least half of the IC members must be women
Action Required for compliance: Where 10 or more employees exist at a location, constitute an Internal Committee with a senior woman Presiding Officer, employee members, one external NGO member, and at least 50% women members.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Internal Committee mandatory only where 10 or more employees are engaged at that location

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Prevention of Sexual Harassment at Work Place Act
Brief Description of compliance:
Number of sexual-harassment complaints received during the year.
Number of complaints disposed of during the year
Number of cases pending for more than 90 days
Number of workshops/awareness programmes conducted
Nature of action taken by the employer/District Officer
Action Required for compliance: Compile and file the Annual POSH Report (complaints received/disposed/pending, awareness programmes, action taken) as required under Section 21/Rule 14 each year.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Do not advertise, market, book, sell or offer the project for sale before obtaining RERA registration, where registration is required.
Action Required for compliance: Do not advertise, market, book or sell any unit until RERA registration for the project has been obtained, where registration is required.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Prominently mention the MahaRERA registration number in advertisements/prospectus.
Action Required for compliance: Prominently display the MahaRERA registration number on every advertisement, hoarding, brochure and prospectus for the project.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Advertisement/prospectus must prominently mention the website address of the Authority where registered-project details are available.
Action Required for compliance: Include the RERA Authority's website address (where registered project details are available) in every advertisement/prospectus.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure marketing claims, project particulars, configurations, amenities and other representations are consistent with information submitted to RERA.
Action Required for compliance: Cross-check every marketing campaign's claims, configurations and amenities against the details filed with RERA before release, and correct any mismatch.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Approved Marketing Material, RERA Disclosure Checklist
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure statements and representations in advertisements/prospectuses are true and accurate.
Action Required for compliance: Review and verify all statements/representations in advertisements and prospectuses for accuracy before publication.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Do not accept more than 10% of the cost of the apartment/plot/building as advance/application fee without first entering into a written and registered Agreement for Sale.
Action Required for compliance: Do not collect more than 10% of the unit cost as advance/application money without first executing a registered Agreement for Sale.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Application Form, Agreement for Sale, Payment Record
Penalty/ Implications: Section 59 / applicable penalty, depending on contravention
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Maintain/update project information on the Authority's website, including registration details and prescribed project information.
Action Required for compliance: Keep the project information on the RERA Authority's website (registration details, status, etc.) updated periodically as required.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Ensure marketing/sales practices do not involve false or misleading representations regarding quality, standard, approval, benefits, services, etc.
Action Required for compliance: Review all marketing/sales collateral to ensure no false or misleading representation is made regarding quality, standard, approvals or benefits before release.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Advertisement Approval Checklist, Claim Substantiation File
Penalty/ Implications: Directions, compensation and other statutory consequences
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Establish a process for receiving, investigating and responding to consumer complaints.
Action Required for compliance: Establish and operate a documented process to receive, investigate and respond to consumer complaints within defined timelines.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Comply with orders relating to refund, replacement/rectification, compensation, discontinuance of unfair trade practice, etc.
Action Required for compliance: Comply with any Consumer Commission order for refund, replacement, rectification, compensation or discontinuance of an unfair trade practice within the stipulated time.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Obtain permission/licence before reproducing, publishing, communicating, adapting or otherwise using copyrighted works owned by third parties.
Action Required for compliance: Obtain written permission/licence from the rights-holder before using any third-party copyrighted material (images, content, music, etc.) in marketing collateral.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Licence Agreement, Assignment Agreement, Permission Records
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Filing of Form 3
Action Required for compliance: Prepare and file Form 3 (quarterly progress/financial statement) with MahaRERA for each registered project by the quarterly due date.
Penalty/ Implications: The RERA Authority issues a show-cause notice, and if unresolved, imposes a penalty of ₹50,000 per project.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Filing of Form 5
Action Required for compliance: Prepare and file Form 5 (annual CA-certified statement of project accounts) with MahaRERA within the prescribed annual timeline.
Penalty/ Implications: The RERA Authority issues a show-cause notice, and if unresolved, imposes a penalty of ₹50,000 per project.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Furnish a ITR in assessable  tax year
Action Required for compliance: Prepare and file the company's Income Tax Return (ITR) for the relevant tax year on or before the statutory due date.
Penalty/ Implications:
Section 423: Interest @1% per month for the delay in filing ITR
Section 428: Fee for default in furnishing return of income
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Get it's accounts audited if - 
 - Turnover > Rs. 1 Cr (For Standard Business)
 - Turnover > Rs. 10 Cr (Where total cash receipts / payments do not exceed 5% of total transactions)
Action Required for compliance: Assess turnover against the tax-audit thresholds (Rs.1 crore standard / Rs.10 crore where cash transactions are within 5%) each year and get accounts audited under Section 44AB/263 if applicable.
Penalty/ Implications:
Penalty levied under Section 428(c):
₹75,000: For missing the deadline by up to one month
₹1,50,000: For any delay extending beyond one month
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Tax audit applicable only if turnover exceeds Rs.1 crore (standard) or Rs.10 crore (where cash transactions are within 5%)

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Advance tax must be paid on a quarterly basis, if the net estimated tax liability of an assessee for the year is ₹10,000 or more
Action Required for compliance: Estimate annual tax liability; where it is Rs.10,000 or more, compute and deposit advance tax in quarterly instalments by the due dates.
Due Date:
Q1 - 15th Jun
Q2 - 15th Sept
Q3 - 15th Dec
Q4 - 15th Mar
Penalty/ Implications:
Section 424: Interest for defaults in payment of Advance tax
Section 425: Interest for deferment of Advance tax
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: TDS to be Deducted and paid where applicable

Due Date:
For Apr to Feb - 7th day of next month
For Mar - 30th April
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: File TDS return quarterly
Action Required for compliance: File the quarterly TDS/TCS statement in the prescribed form, reflecting correct deductee-wise tax credit, by the statutory due date.
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Form 138 (Salary), Form 140 (Non-salary) & Form 143 (TCS), Form 141 (Purchase of Immovable Property)
Due Date:
Q1 - 31st Jul
Q2 - 31st Oct
Q3 - 31st Jan
Q4 - 31st May
