Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
GSTR-1: Every registered taxpayer making a supply of goods or services, or both, is required to furnish the details of outward supplies in the prescribed monthly return.
GSTR-3B: It is a self-declared, simplified monthly summary return that taxpayers use to report their total GST liabilities, claim eligible Input Tax Credit (ITC) and discharge tax dues.
Action Required for compliance: File GSTR-1 (outward supply details) and GSTR-3B (summary return with ITC claim and tax payment) every month by their respective due dates.
Due Date:
GSTR-1 - 11th day of next month
GSTR-3B - 20th day of next month
Penalty/ Implications: Section 47(1): Late fee of Rs. 100 per day maximum upto Rs. 5,000/-
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
GSTR-9: Mandatory for every registered taxpayer whose aggregate turnover exceeds Rs. 2 crore, summarizing all outward and inward supplies for the financial year.
GSTR-9C: Mandatory for taxpayers whose aggregate turnover exceeds Rs. 5 crore, requiring a self-certified reconciliation statement to align GST data with audited financial statements.
Action Required for compliance: Where aggregate turnover exceeds Rs.2 crore, file the annual return GSTR-9; where it exceeds Rs.5 crore, additionally file the self-certified reconciliation statement GSTR-9C.
Penalty/ Implications: Section 47(1): Late fee of Rs. 100 per day maximum upto 0.25% of Turnover in that state
Applicability / Trigger Condition: GSTR-9 applicable only if aggregate turnover exceeds Rs.2 crore; GSTR-9C only if it exceeds Rs.5 crore

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Maharashtra State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1975
Brief Description of compliance: Deduct Profession Tax  from monthly salaries and remit it to the government.
Action Required for compliance: Deduct Professional Tax from employees' salaries above the prescribed slab each month and remit it to the State Government by the due date, along with the employer's own PT registration/payment.
Penalty/ Implications:
Section 9(2):  Interest on late payment - 
-  1st month of delay: 1.25% per month
 - 2nd & 3rd month of delay: 1.50% per month 
 - 4th month onwards: 2% per month
Section 9(5): Penalty may impose equal to 10% of Total tax due
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Reference Section/Rule: Sec 15 of MSMED Act and Sec 37 of Income Tax Act, 2025
Brief Description of compliance: Payment of MSMEs to be made within 45 days.
Action Required for compliance: Verify vendor MSME (Udyam) registration status and ensure payments to Micro/Small enterprises are released within 45 days of acceptance of goods/services.
Penalty/ Implications: Expenditure will be disllowed if not paid within 45 days, and it will be allowed in next year once it is paid.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the vendor/payee is a registered Micro or Small enterprise under MSMED Act

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Affix name and RO outside every office
Action Required for compliance:
Display the company's name and other prescribed particulars outside every office/place of business.

Company's name, registered office address and CIN, along with other prescribed particulars, should appear on business letters, billheads, letterheads, notices and official publications
Penalty/ Implications: the company and every officer who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of one thousand rupees for every day during which the default continues but not exceeding one lakh rupees.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Certificate issued/Shares credited to demat account of the Shareholders
Action Required for compliance:
1. Certificates to be signed by atleast 2 Directors
2. Certificate to be issued within 60 days of allotment and upon payment of stamp duty on such certificates
3. Dematerialise shares in case of private companies which is not a small company
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Duty to register Charge by the Company on its property or assets or any of its undertakings, whether tangible or otherwise, and situated in or outside India, to register the particulars of the charge signed by the company and the charge-holder together with the instruments, if any,
Action Required for compliance: upon execution of Mortgage/Hypothecation/Release deed with the Bank file Form with the ROC for Creation/Modification/Satisfaction of Charge
Forms filed or document submitted to any:
1. CHG-1 for creation/modification of Charge
2. CHG-4 for Satisfaction of Charge
Due Date: Entires shall be made forthwith after the creation, modification or satisfaction of charge
Penalty/ Implications: The company shall be liable to a penalty of five lakh rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of fifty thousand rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Maintain register of charges
Action Required for compliance:
1. The entries in the register of charges maintained by the company 
2.  Entries in the register shall be authenticated
Due Date: Entires shall be made within 7 days after the Board of Directors  approves the allotment or transfer of shares, debentures or any other securities
Penalty/ Implications: The company shall be liable to a penalty of five lakh rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of fifty thousand rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Maintain register seperately for each class of shareholder
Action Required for compliance:
Every company shall keep and maintain the following registers:
1. Register of Members
2. Register of Debenture holders
3. Register of any other security holders
Penalty/ Implications: The company   shall be liable to a penalty of three lakh rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of fifty thousand rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Preparation of Annual return for end of every Financial Year. To be filed with ROC within 60 days of AGM
Action Required for compliance: Not specified in source
Penalty/ Implications: The company and its every officer who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of Rs. 10,000/- and in case of continuing failure, with further penalty of Rs. 100/- for each day during which such failure continues, subject to a maximum of Rs. 2,00,000/- in case of a company and Rs. 50,000/- in case of an officer who is in default
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
1. Every Company shall hold one AGM in a FY and not more than 15 months shall elapse between two AGMs
2. AGM to be called during business hours (9AM to 6PM) except National Holiday, in the same city where the Registered Office is situated
Action Required for compliance:
1. Notice of AGM alongwith financials to be circulated atleast 21 days' prior to the date of AGM
2. Adoption of Accounts by the members in the AGM
Penalty/ Implications: the company and every officer of the company who is in default shall be punishable with fine which may extend to one lakh rupees and in the case of a continuing default, with a further fine which may extend to five thousand rupees for every day during which such default continues
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Minutes of each meeting shall be entered into Minutes Book along with date of such entry, within 30 days of conclusion of meeting
Action Required for compliance: Secretarial Standards to be followed
Penalty/ Implications: the company shall be liable to a penalty of twenty-five thousand rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of five thousand rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Financial Statements to be prepared as per accounting standards and Schedule III
Action Required for compliance:
1. Placing of Financials before the Board before every AGM
2. In case of one or more subsidiaries, prepare consolidated financials
3.Filing of adopted standalone & consolidated financials in Form AOC-4 (XBRL) to ROC within 30 days of holding of AGM
Penalty/ Implications: the managing director, the whole-time director in charge of finance, the Chief Financial Officer or any other person charged by the Board with the duty of complying with the requirements of this section and in the absence of any of the officers mentioned above, all the Directors shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year or with fine which shall not be less than fifty thousand rupees but which may extend to five lakh rupees, or with both
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only to companies required to constitute an Audit Committee under Section 177 (listed companies and prescribed classes of public companies)

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: The report of the Board of Directors to be attached to the financial statement
Action Required for compliance: Board's report shall include all the items specified under section 134 and rules thereunder
Due Date:
1. Spend towards CSR till 30th March of FY

2. File CSR-2 after filing AOC-4
Penalty/ Implications: the company shall be liable to a penalty of three lakh rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of fifty thousand rupees.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only to companies required to constitute a Nomination & Remuneration Committee under Section 178

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Threshold for Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR): 
1. Networth>500 Cr. or 
2. Turnover>1000 Cr. or 
3. Net Profit > 5 Cr. 
in the immediately preceding FY
Action Required for compliance:
1. Formation of CSR Committeee
2. Allocation of 2% of avg net profits of preceding three FY towards CSR 
3. Disclosure of CSR in the Board's report
4. Filing CSR-2
Penalty/ Implications: the company shall be liable to a penalty of twice the amount required to be transferred by the company to the Fund specified in Schedule VII or the Unspent Corporate Social Responsibility Account, as the case may be, or one crore rupees, whichever is less, and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of one-tenth of the amount required to be transferred by the company to such Fund specified in Schedule VII, or the Unspent Corporate Social Responsibility Account, as the case may be, or two lakh rupees, whichever is less
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Private Co. having turnover of Rs. 200  crore or more or o/s loans from banks of more than Rs. 100 crore during the preceding FY shall appoint Internal auditor
Action Required for compliance: Appoint an internal auditor, who shall either be a chartered accountant or a cost accountant, or such other professional as may be decided by the Board to conduct internal audit of the functions and activities of the company
Penalty/ Implications:
A fine of ₹10,000 for initial non-compliance.
An additional fine of ₹1,000 for each day the non-compliance continues, up to a certain limit
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Company shall appoint Statutory Auditor (Individual or Firm) for a term of 5 yrs
Action Required for compliance:
1. Obtaining consent & eligibility certificate from the proposed Auditors
2. Hold BM/GM to approve appointment of Auditors
3. Filing of Form with the ROC within 15 days of the appointment
Due Date:
1. CRA 2 - Within 6 months of end of FY
2. CRA-4 - Within one month of receipt of Audit Report
Penalty/ Implications: the company shall be punishable with fine which shall not be less than twenty-five thousand rupees but which may extend to five lakh rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be punishable with fine which shall not be less than ten thousand rupees but which may extend to one lakh rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Class of Companies specified under the Section and having an overall turnover from all its products and services of Rs. 35 Crore or more during the immediately preceding financial year, shall include cost records for such products or services in their books of account
Action Required for compliance:
1. Obtaining consent & eligibility certificate from the proposed Cost Auditors
2. Hold BM to approve appointment of Auditors (within 180 days of closure of FY)
3. Filing of Form with the ROC within 30 days of the appointment
4. Ratification of remuneration of cost auditor in the AGM
5. Filing of cot audit report with the ROC within 30 days of receipt of report
Due Date: DIR-12 to be filed within 30 days of appointment of Director
Penalty/ Implications: the company shall be punishable with fine which shall not be less than twenty-five thousand rupees but which may extend to five lakh rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be punishable with fine which shall not be less than ten thousand rupees but which may extend to one lakh rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only to companies meeting the Secretarial Audit thresholds prescribed under Section 204/Rule 9

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Every company shall have a Board of Directors consisting of individuals as Directors
Action Required for compliance:
1. Atleast two Directors in case of Pvt Companies
2. Every company shall have at least one director who has stayed in India for a total period of not less than 182 days during the financial year
3. No person shall be appointed as a director of a company unless he has been allotted the DIN
4. every director shall be appointed by the company in general meeting
5. a director shall not act as a director unless he gives his consent to hold the office as director and such consent has been filed with the Registrar within thirty days of his appointment
Penalty/ Implications: the company and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of fifty thousand rupees, and in case of continuing failure, with a further penalty of five hundred rupees for each day during which such failure continues, subject to a maximum of three lakh rupees in case of a company and one lakh rupees in case of an officer who is in default.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only to companies meeting the CSR thresholds under Section 135 (net worth/turnover/net profit criteria)

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
Register of directors and key managerial personnel and their shareholding -every company must maintain, at its registered office, a register containing the prescribed particulars of its:

Directors; and
Key Managerial Personnel (KMP).
Action Required for compliance:
1. Maintain register of particulars of Directors/KMPs & their Shareholding  
2. Intimation of change in particulars of Directors to ROC in Form DIR-6
Penalty/ Implications: the company and every officer of the company who is in default shall be liable to a penalty of fifty thousand rupees, and in case of continuing failure, with a further penalty of five hundred rupees for each day during which such failure continues, subject to a maximum of three lakh rupees in case of a company and one lakh rupees in case of an officer who is in default.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Company shall have at least 4 meetings in a Financial Year by giving 7 days notice prior to the date of meeting
Action Required for compliance:
1. Meeting can be held either in person or through video conferencing or other audio visual means
2. meeting to be called by giving not less than 7 day's notice
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Every director shall disclose their interest in company/firms/other association at every first meeting of the Financial Year & whenever there are changes anytime during the year
Action Required for compliance: Check master data of Directors in the MCA website and prepare disclosure
Penalty/ Implications: such director shall be liable to a penalty of one lakh rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance:
(1) No company shall, directly or indirectly, advance any loan, including any loan represented by a book debt to, or give any guarantee or provide any security in connection with any loan taken by,—
(a) any director of company, or of a company which is its holding company or any partner or relative of any such director; or
(b) any firm in which any such director or relative is a partner.

(2) A company may advance any loan including any loan represented by a book debt, or give any guarantee or provide any security in connection with any loan taken by any person in whom any of the director of the company is interested, subject to the condition that—:
(a) a special resolution is passed by the company in general meeting:
(b) the loans are utilised by the borrowing company for its principal business activities.
Action Required for compliance:
1. Any loan/guarantee/security given to a Related Party (pvt ltd co.) is to be approved by the Shareholders in a general meeting

2. Special resolution passed u/s 185 is to be filed with the ROC within 30 days of meeting
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Action Required for compliance:
1. If limit exceeds amount prescribed u/s 186, approval of Shareholders to be obtained

2. Filing of sepecial resolution passed with the ROC within 30 days of meeting

3. Maintain register of loan/guarantee/security/investment made
Penalty/ Implications: the company shall be punishable with fine which shall not be less than twenty-five thousand rupees but which may extend to five lakh rupees and every officer of the company who is in default shall be punishable with imprisonment for a term which may extend to two years and with fine which shall not be less than twenty-five thousand rupees but which may extend to one lakh rupees
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Action Required for compliance:
Obtain approvals and maintain records for applicable related-party transactions.

Shareholders' approval is required where the transaction exceeds the applicable prescribed limits, broadly:

1. Sale/purchase/supply of goods/materials: 10% of turnover or Rs. 100 crore, whichever is lower
2. Sale/purchase of property: 10% of net worth
3. Lease of property: 10% of turnover
4. Availing/rendering services: 10% of turnover
5. Office/place of profit: remuneration exceeding Rs. 2.5 lakh per month
6. Underwriting: exceeding 1% of net worth
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where individual(s) meet the Significant Beneficial Owner criteria under Section 90/Rules

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Company having outstanding loans/borrowings from banks or public financial institutions of Rs. 100 crore or more
Action Required for compliance:
The Secretarial Auditor must be a Company Secretary in Practice. The Board should approve the appointment of the PCS.

The PCS is required to examine compliance with applicable laws and regulations relevant to the company.

Under Section 204(3), if the Secretarial Auditor makes any qualification, observation or other remark, the Board's Report must explain the same in full.

The final Secretarial Audit Report is annexed to the Board's Report.
Due Date: 30th day of June of every year
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Reference Section/Rule:
rule 16 and 16A of the of the Companies
(Acceptance of Deposits) Rules, 2014
Brief Description of compliance: filing return of deposit or particulars of transaction not considered as deposit or both by every company other than Government company.
Action Required for compliance: Every private company shall disclose in its financial statement, by way of notes, about the money received from the directors, or relatives of directors
Due Date: on or before June 30 of the relevant year
Penalty/ Implications: The company who is in default shall be punishable with fine which may extend to five thousand rupees and where the contravention is a continuing one, with a further fine which may extend to five hundred rupees for every day after the first day during which the contravention continues
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Reference Section/Rule: Rule 12(A) - The Companies (Appointment & Qualification of Directors)Rules, 2014
Brief Description of compliance:
Instead of the annual filing, Directors holding a Director Identification Number (DIN) as of March 31 must now file Form DIR-3 KYC Web only once every three consecutive financial years.

 The deadline for this triennial filing is on or before June 30 of the relevant year.

 If there are any changes to your mobile number, email address, or residential address, you must update them within 30 days of the change using the DIR-3 KYC Web form.
Action Required for compliance: For Web KYC obtain OTP from respective directors to authenticate details on MCA portal
Penalty/ Implications: DIN status is updated with a remark of 'Deactivated due to Non-Filing of DIR-3 KYC'. Such directors also have to file this KYC Form along with a penalty of Rs. 5,000 to reactivate their DIN
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: RBI has mandated LEI number for corporate borrowers having aggregate fund-based and non-fund based credit exposure of ₹ 5 crore and above from any bank to obtain Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) registration
Action Required for compliance:
1. Obtain LEI code from issuer authorised to provide LEI code to entities
2. Circulate the code to relevant authorities
3. Renewal of LEI before its expiry
Penalty/ Implications: Borrowers who fail to obtain LEI codes as per the schedule will not be granted renewal or enhancement of credit facilities.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company accepts/proposes to accept FDI in construction-development activity

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013
Brief Description of compliance: Formation of Internal Complaints Committee  (ICC)
Action Required for compliance: Members: One Presiding Officer (a woman employed at Senior level), two  employees and one member of NGO/association committed to the cause
Due Date: ICC members to hold office for 3 years
Penalty/ Implications: Results in a penalty of up to ₹50,000, and repeated offenses can lead to cancellation or non-renewal of business licenses
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company undertakes construction-development activity involving foreign investment

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act, 2013
Brief Description of compliance: Submission of Annual report to Disctrict Officer
Action Required for compliance: Annual report to be prepared in each calendar year and submitted to the District Officer
Penalty/ Implications: Results in a penalty of up to ₹50,000, and repeated offenses can lead to cancellation or non-renewal of business licenses
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company undertakes EPC/turnkey/civil construction projects abroad

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Reference Section/Rule: Foreign Exchange Management (Overseas Investment) Rules, 2022, OI Regulations, 2022 and RBI Master Direction – Overseas Investment
Action Required for compliance:
Verify that the Indian company is eligible to make ODI and that proposed foreign business/activity is permissible under FEMA/OI Rules

Check Sections 179, 186 and other applicable provisions under companies act

Appoint designated AD Category-I bank and submit Form FC and supporting documents

Obtain UIN for foreign entity before remittance
Submit Form A2 for remittance
Forms filed or document submitted to any:
APR -File Annual Performance Report by 31 December

FLA -File FLA Return by 15 July
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where the company has export transactions

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Action Required for compliance:
The company is required to report the issue/allotment through the RBI's prescribed reporting mechanism.

The reporting is made through the FIRMS portal, through the designated AD Category-I Bank.
Forms filed or document submitted to any:
FC-GPR = reporting of issue of equity instruments to non-resident

FLA = annual reporting of foreign liabilities/assets

FC-TRS — if shares are subsequently transferred
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable only where advance payment is received against exports

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Developers must register all real estate projects with RERA before advertising or selling. This includes providing project details (land title, plan, approvals, etc.).
Action Required for compliance: Register every real estate project with RERA before advertising, marketing or selling, submitting land title, sanctioned plan and approval documents as required.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty of up to 10% of the estimated project cost or imprisonment for up to 3 years, or fine of further 10% of the estimated project cost.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016
Brief Description of compliance:
Extension of
registration- 

The registration may be extended by the Authority on an application made by the promoter due to force majeure, in such form and on payment of such fee as may be specified by regulations made by the Authority
Action Required for compliance: Where completion is delayed due to force majeure, apply to the Authority for extension of project registration in the specified form with the prescribed fee before the registration lapses.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Developers must update the construction progress and other relevant details on the RERA portal, typically every quarter.
Action Required for compliance: Update construction progress and other project details on the RERA portal every quarter (and confirm annually) within the prescribed timeline.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty of up to 5% of the estimated project cost
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Builders must disclose the carpet area of the project at the time of registration and ensure buyers are provided accurate information about the size of units.
Action Required for compliance: Disclose the exact carpet area of each unit at the time of RERA registration and ensure this figure is consistently communicated to buyers in agreements/collateral.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty of up to 5% of the estimated project cost
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: The developer must submit a completion certificate to RERA before handing over the property to buyers.
Action Required for compliance: Obtain the Completion/Occupation Certificate and submit it to RERA before handing over possession of units to buyers.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty of up to 5% of the estimated project cost
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Developers must guarantee against structural defects for 5 years from the date of possession .
Action Required for compliance: Track the 5-year structural defect liability period from the date of possession and rectify any qualifying structural defect reported within that period at no cost to the buyer.
Penalty/ Implications: Compensation + Penalty of up to 5% of the estimated project cost
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance:
Adrvertisement Guidelines - The advertisement or prospectus issued or published shall mention
prominently the website address of the Authority and include the registration number obtained from the Authority
Action Required for compliance: Ensure every advertisement/prospectus prominently displays the Authority's website address and the project's RERA registration number as mandated by Order 46C/2025.
Penalty/ Implications: Return entire investment by customer with interest and compensation
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Maintain font size of the MahaRERA Registration number and website address equal to or larger than the Project contact details and address\
Action Required for compliance: Set the font size of the MahaRERA registration number and website address equal to or larger than the project's contact/address details in all advertisements.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty which may extend upto INR 50,000
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: MahaRERA Registration number, website address, QR Code (detactable by software applications) shall be placed in a top-right quadrant in a colur with high visibility
Action Required for compliance: Place the MahaRERA registration number, website address and a software-scannable QR code in the top-right quadrant of advertisements in a high-visibility colour.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty which may extend upto INR 50,000
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Developers must maintain an escrow account for the project, where 70% of the project funding must be used only for construction activities.
Action Required for compliance: Open and maintain a project-specific RERA escrow account, ensuring at least 70% of amounts collected from buyers are deposited and withdrawn only for construction and land costs.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty of up to 5% of the estimated project cost
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Registration of Sale Agreements and Contracts
Brief Description of compliance: Sale agreements must be registered with RERA, and the buyer must receive a copy. Ensures transparency in terms and conditions.
Action Required for compliance: Ensure every Agreement for Sale is executed and registered with the Sub-Registrar as required, and hand a copy to each buyer.
Penalty/ Implications: Penalty of up to 5% of the estimated project cost
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Regulation: Formation of legal entity of customers
Brief Description of compliance:
Developer to enable the formation of an association or society or co-operative society, as
the case may be.
Action Required for compliance: On completion, facilitate and complete formation of the buyers' association/society/co-operative society as required under Section 11.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Project Level (To be mapped against each live and new project)
Brief Description of compliance: Developers must complete the process for transferring ownership to buyers once the project is complete, ensuring that registration is done with appropriate authorities.
Action Required for compliance: On project completion, complete conveyance/transfer of ownership (title, common areas) to the buyers'/association and register it with the appropriate authority.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: The Real Estate (Regulation and Development) Act, 2016
Brief Description of compliance: Respond to notices and attend hearings.
Action Required for compliance: Respond to any RERA notice and depute an authorised representative to attend hearings before the Authority/Tribunal within stipulated timelines.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Constitution of Works Committee-
Action Required for compliance: Where applicable thresholds are met, constitute a Works Committee with equal employer-employee representation as prescribed.
Due Date: Penalty under Section 86-Fine up to ₹1 lakh
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Grievance Redressal Committee
Action Required for compliance: Constitute a Grievance Redressal Committee at establishments as prescribed and ensure worker grievances are addressed within the specified timeframe.
Due Date: Penalty under Section 86-Fine up to ₹1 lakh
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Recovery of Money Due
Action Required for compliance: Address employee claims for recovery of money due (wages, dues) promptly to avoid recovery proceedings before the designated authority.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Strikes and Lock-outs
Action Required for compliance: Follow the prescribed notice and procedural requirements before any strike or lock-out, and ensure legal compliance if one occurs.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Lay-off Compensation
Action Required for compliance: Compute and pay lay-off compensation to eligible workers as prescribed whenever a lay-off is declared.
Due Date: Penalty under Section 86-Fine up to ₹1 lakh
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Retrenchment Compensation
Action Required for compliance: Compute and pay retrenchment compensation and follow the prescribed notice/procedure before retrenching any workman.
Due Date: Penalty under Section 86-Fine up to ₹1 lakh
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Brief Description of compliance: Transfer and Closure Compensation
Action Required for compliance: Follow prescribed notice and compensation requirements before any transfer of undertaking or closure of establishment.
Due Date: Penalty under Section 86-Fine up to ₹1 lakh
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Applicable to all covered establishments/projects

Compliance Type: Entity Level
Regulation: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
Brief Description of compliance: The Act shall apply when the Government acquires land for public purpose and for rehabilitation and resettlement connected therewith.
Action Required for compliance:
The Act applies when the Appropriate Government acquires land for:

Government use, hold and control, including for Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs).
Public Purpose Projects, including:

Strategic and defence purposes.
Infrastructure projects.
Industrial corridors and manufacturing zones.
Water supply, sanitation, and conservation projects.
Government educational and research institutions.
Housing projects.
Planned urban and rural development.
Rehabilitation of project-affected families.

Public-Private Partnership (PPP) Projects

Where ownership of the land continues to vest with the Government.
Requires prior consent of at least 70% of affected families.

Private Company Projects for Public Purpose

Acquisition is permitted only for a recognized public purpose.
Requires prior consent of at least 80% of affected families.

Rehabilitation and Resettlement

Whenever acquisition displaces affected families and triggers R&R obligations under the Act.
Action Required for Compliance
Confirm that the acquisition falls within a permitted public purpose.
Conduct a Social Impact Assessment (SIA) where required.
Obtain prescribed consent from affected families for PPP/private projects.
Pay compensation as determined under the Act.
Implement Rehabilitation & Resettlement (R&R) measures.
Maintain all acquisition notifications, consent records, compensation awards, and R&R documentation
Forms filed or document submitted to any: Valid Lift Working License framed in Lift Car
Penalty/ Implications: Acquisition process may be invalid if Act requirements are not followed.
Applicability / Trigger Condition: Conditional - applicable only if the Government initiates compulsory acquisition of the company's project land for a public purpose
